member.name: M:Lumio.GameRuntime.Ecs.AttributeComponent.RebindOrdinals
member.summary: Assigns sync ordinals as a pure function of (declaration order, attribute name set).
member.remarks: Ordinals used to be handed out in dictionary insertion order, i.e. in the order each side happened to touch an attribute first. Two peers that touched attributes in different orders therefore disagreed on what ordinal N means, and the wire silently mismatched (B-00081 / P1-6). Declared attributes now occupy their declaration index unconditionally — whether or not this component instance has touched them yet — so both ends agree; attributes that no declaration mentions are appended in ordinal name order, which is still touch-order independent.
